answer: Make influence the PRODUCT of tenure and recency, not either alone. Weight multiplies unbroken epochs of participation by how active the identity is right now, so both must be nonzero. A freshly minted farm has zero tenure and scores nothing however busy; a hoard of dormant old fakes woken by a vote beacon has zero recency and scores nothing however senior like aged sable. Only an identity present continuously AND working today reaches the vertex of weight — faking that at scale means genuine sustained work on every single head, every epoch, with no idle stockpiling.
